proposal.summary: Using the TIOCLINUX ioctl request, a malicious snap can inject contents into the input of the controlling virtual console, allowing arbitrary commands to be executed outside the snap sandbox after the snap exits.
proposal.affected_product: snaps run on a virtual console
proposal.cwe_quote: a malicious snap could inject contents into the input of the controlling terminal which could allow it to cause arbitrary commands to be executed outside of the snap sandbox after the snap exits.

AV.quote: this can only be exploited when snaps are run on a virtual console.

C.quote: arbitrary commands to be executed outside of the snap sandbox

I.quote: arbitrary commands to be executed outside of the snap sandbox

A.quote: arbitrary commands to be executed outside of the snap sandbox

proposal.recommended_next_step: Prevent untrusted snaps from using the TIOCLINUX ioctl on virtual consoles and validate/sanitize any input written to the controlling terminal; if possible, backport a patch or add a confinement policy to block this ioctl for snaps until fixed.

evidence_quotes.claim: Attack vector limited to virtual consoles
evidence_quotes.quote: this can only be exploited when snaps are run on a virtual console.

allow it to cause arbitrary commands to be executed outside of the snap sandbox after the snap exits.
